Container.Name: im-overdue
Container.Overview: Personal time account with calendar evidence imports, working-time entries, leave tracking and reports. Single-user password login; all application data stays in a local SQLite database. No external service credentials or automatic time tracking. Configure the exact browser-facing app URL and a private password before starting.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: time tracking overtime calendar work hours leave self hosted
Container.Requires: A dedicated appdata directory containing only im-overdue.sqlite and its SQLite WAL/SHM files. Root initializes only these paths, then the app runs as PUID/PGID. HTTP is unencrypted; use HTTPS at a reverse proxy for remote access. When using HTTPS, also set the advanced WebUI field to the same configured app URL. See the deployment guide.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port. Include the published host port in App URL.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated directory for this app only. Do not map the appdata parent. Files get private permissions and PUID/PGID ownership.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Required exact browser address, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:4317 or https://time.example.net. No path or trailing slash. HTTPS requires the reverse proxy to preserve Host and the advanced WebUI field to match.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Required unique password: 12-256 characters, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Change here and restart to replace it and invalidate all sessions. Stored in Unraid's container configuration.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges of your reverse proxy, e.g. 172.16.0.0/12. Its X-Forwarded-For header then identifies each browser for the login limit. Leave empty without a proxy.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root numeric user ID after initialization; Unraid nobody is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Non-root numeric group ID after initialization; Unraid users is 100.
